name: Kimie
quote: She waltzes through a faraway dreamscape as the bells chime.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Dawn sheds its light and all things stir, making this the ideal time to sweep the premises clean. I have already cleansed this place for you; would you like to rest a little longer, Professor?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Perhaps today's tasks might be a little... Hm? But you have not dined or rested yet. Please accept this plate of sushi. I hope it will help you recover the energy you need when you have a moment available to partake in it.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Twilight spreads its wings as the world slips into night. They call this the witching hour. Although this place has no legends of night demons bewitching people with their voices, I would still urge you to take care of yourself.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: All will return to slumber, and all will awaken again. The hour is lonesome, and I hope you will sleep soon to replenish your energy in preparation for tomorrow.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Unlike the other Dolls with their wealth of experience, prayer, worship, and cleaning have been my lot in life at Kurenoyume Shrine. If you so desire, I shall apply myself to the study of other arts—What? You are happy with this? Hm... I understand. Thank you for your care. Even outside the shrine, I will continue to pray for your continued welfare and good fortunes.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text:
I can always smell the faint scent of flowers here, which makes me think of Kurenoyume Shrine. Surely the flowers must be well cared for by the residents in the Oasis. As the poem goes, 
"On the great temple bell
stopped from flight
the small butterfly." I wonder if everything we experience in the cloud is likewise a dream or merely a joke played on us by the kami...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Surely you must be tired after working so hard. Have a good rest; I, Kimie, shall watch over you.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: In keeping with your instructions, please come with me.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: This is a ceremonial item, and it is essential for my rites.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: What would you have me do?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: I will sincerely pray for your good fortune.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: In keeping with your arrangements.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Greetings, I am Kimie, the miko of Kurenoyume Shrine. I will be accompanying you from this day forth as I place myself in your care.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Following the guidance of the kami...

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: The signs of the kami guide me ever onward.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Night falls and the moon illuminates the land. As we dance the kagura, the shroud of dreams spreads... May the kami hear our prayers.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Is there no way to avoid this conflict, then... I understand.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Let us pen this page of history together.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: May the mercy of the kami wipe away your pain!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: A mere trifle; it is nothing to be concerned over.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Pardon me.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: All things... wax and wane...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: Is this... A keepsake? Am I correct to interpret this as your wish to form a special relationship with a miko like myself? ...I see. Before I met you, I had never thought that someday, I would be able to truly connect with the mundane world in this way. But if it is with you... Then with the kami as my witness, I shall walk by your side, and never shall we be parted.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Being able to see you at the beginning of the new year is a good omen. Happy New Year, Professor. This is a Kurenoyume omamori that I made for you, and I hope you will keep it on your person. May it protect you and bring you good luck.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Valentine's Day...? Visitors would oft visit the shrine on this day to make wishes and pray that the relationships that they dream of will become a reality. I learned how to make chocolate after coming to the Oasis, and I tried my hand at making some in the image of the petals of the shrine's flowers. I hope these delicious blossoms will grant you good fortune in your romantic endeavors.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: If we were in reality right now, shrines today would probably be filled with people diligently preparing for Tanabata. In addition to putting up the decorations, one must also remember to hang up the bamboo slips on which wishes are written. Do you have any wishes written, Professor? I will hang them up for you in the highest place so that your prayers might reach the heavens.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: This practice of Halloween is surprisingly lively. The living dresses up as monsters and wander the streets. At first, it was a way for people to banish fiends, but eventually it became a form of celebration. The evolution of human culture is most amusing. Hm... Shall we also don hannya masks to get into the festive spirit?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: In the heart of winter, where the cold winds carry the freezing snow on their currents, the best place to be is resting in a warm place. The shrine has always welcomed travelers harried by blizzards, which is how I came to learn a few interesting stories about the outside world. I have stoked my hearth tonight; would you be so kind as to spare me a few moments of your time and spend this snowy night with me, and grant me the favor of your many stories?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Today is a most important day, for it is your birthday. If you were a work of writing, then your birthday would be the anniversary of its penning. And it is thanks to those strokes that I am fortunate enough to take part in the story of your life, a most unusual yet wonderful connection. I will pray for your continued good fortune on this day of miracles that is uniquely yours.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud!

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
In this world, we can maintain the safety and security of this domain while ensuring its residents may live and work in peace, much like the blessed lands in the books. Despite the differences between the cloud, this shrine and the real world, I am nevertheless willing to offer up my all. However, I have resided overlong within the shrine, so if I should misspeak or if I should act inappropriately, I would appreciate it if you would help point them out.
...Hm? I need not be so reserved? Mm, I will do my best to change my way of speaking, then. Thank you very much, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Is that you, Professor? A moment, please; I'll brew some tea for you right now. The ingredients were made from plants similar to the ones growing in the shrine. I had Souchun-san help with preparing it; hopefully it will suit your tastes. No, it's no trouble at all; I've always been responsible for preparing food and drink in the shrine... My phrasing? Ah... ever since you pointed it out, I've been working on softening my tone in order to make you feel more at ease. I hope I haven't given offense.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: What a marvelous device this is. I've never seen it in the shrine before. It looks quite complex, yet it's so easy to use... Now that you mention it, that applies to me as well, but my environment is such that I've almost forgotten about it. Meanwhile, the objects in the shrine might appear simple, but the ceremonial rites surrounding them are most complex and thus much care is needed when using them. It seems I still have much to learn when it comes to understanding the world.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Dolls are products of science, yet I, as a Doll, find myself bearing an inheritance of tradition. Even I can't help but find that a little strange. Sweeping the yard, conducting ceremonies, praying for others, maintaining the texts... perhaps it seems boring to an onlooker, but to me, one must understand the traditions in order to pass them on. It is in seeking the records of the past in history books, following the footsteps of our forebears on long journeys and listening to the voices of the spirits that my value lies.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: Are you looking for something? These books... Yes, they are the result of my early, clumsy efforts, when I didn't know human history well enough. I apologize for this shameful display. Huh? They're quite something, you say? Well, I feel reassured after hearing you say that. Once, someone asked, "How could a machine hear the voice of the kami" and questioned the purpose of my existence. When I think about it, the way I sought to study the history books to learn how our heritage changed throughout the ages and attempted to follow in the footsteps of the gods all stem from those days when I was lost in self-doubt. To live detached from the mortal world in the shrine and venerate the kami was my original way of life. Now that I have come to the cloud, I ought to try setting foot on a new path by your side.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Is that so…

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehe.

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Ah...

voices.label: Live2D1
voices.text: Everything returns to dreams, just as everything shall wake once more.

voices.label: Live2D2
voices.text: I can always smell the faint scent of flowers here.

voices.label: Live2D3
voices.text: Is this... a token? Should I take this to mean you want to form a special bond with a miko?

voices.label: Live2D4
voices.text: ...With the god as our witness, I vow to follow you, now and forever.

career:
The S55-HMK model Doll known as "Kimie" was a priestess Doll custom-made by Universal Anything Services for Kurenoyume Shrine. The S55-HMK's primary duties were performing daily chores within the shrine, hosting large-scale festivals, and so on. In addition, Kimie was equipped with the most cutting-edge emotional experience modules and a comprehensive domestic function suite in order to care for the commissioner in her twilight years. After considering the risk of censure the S55-HMK might receive from the public, the model was not widely marketed and its development process was highly classified.

After the minor scandal sparked by Kimie's identity as a Doll, Madam Kaede, her owner, requested that she take part in Project Neural Cloud in the hopes that Kimie would find a home after her own passing. Kimie passed the entrance examination shortly after that.
infoStories:
"From the frozen rivers of Karelia to the arctic tundra of Northern Asia, ever since the dawn of civilization, to sense the power of the gods, the mediums, priests, and shrine maidens of old have employed mystic wisdom and ancient rites, using them to heal sickness, grant blessings, and guide the deceased to the afterlife."
 
With the development of science and technology, many ancient faiths and beliefs found themselves with no inheritors and were in danger of disappearing. Even certain religions that were traditionally passed down through familial lines were in danger of being rejected by the very heirs who should have been the ones to carry them on. The outbreak of war only intensified this situation, and with labor pools for regular jobs drying up, picking suitable candidates to hold religious office was even more difficult. As a result, many religions ended up fading from the world entirely.
 
In these tumultuous times, Kurenoyume Shrine found itself struggling to stay afloat. Its owner, Madam Kaede, was an aged shrine maiden who commissioned Universal Anything Services to custom-build the S55-HMK—also known as Kimie—to keep Shinto traditions from dying out. As a custom-built Doll, Kimie was furnished with the necessary knowledge to perform her tasks as well as fulfill the role of a personal companion.
 
"This is our first time developing a Doll like this. Her outstanding specs are little more than icing on the cake; what really matters is her understanding of her emotions and those of others, her sensitivity to interpersonal relationships, and her spiritual beliefs," a researcher who worked on the S55-HMK was quoted.

After bringing Kimie back to Kurenoyume Shrine, Madam Kaede quickly had her take over the daily duties at the shrine. She never once treated Kimie as a Doll, but after considering the effects of public opinion, she chose to conceal Kimie's origins. The worshippers who came to Kurenoyume Shrine found that there was suddenly a fresh young face there, a quiet miko with a gentle smile, but they simply assumed the elderly Madam Kaede had found a successor from some distant parts.
 
Typically speaking, a shrine's miko are distinct from professional religious officials. The former generally serve as assistants to the latter, as well as taking care of the day-to-day tasks at the shrine, in addition to performing the kagura and taking important roles in various festivals. However, there have also been cases where fully-ordained clerics have taken the role of a miko, such as Kimie, who was elevated to a member of the clergy not long after reaching her position. As the central figure of Kurenoyume Shrine, she was responsible for both mundane and spiritual tasks, which she handled in an orderly manner. However, what sparked the most debate was her performance during the kagura dance.
 
According to a participant: "Rather than being a purely artistic performance or a complex rite in keeping with tradition, she managed to combine the two while adding an indescribable layer of nuance to the whole thing— as though she was truly bridging the gap between mankind and the gods, with Kimie-sama serving as the gatekeeper and messenger."

The first impression most people have of Kimie is that she is refined and courteous and that her speech patterns could have come from the Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, the Kokin Wakashu, or The Pillow Book, being full of femininity and archaic phrasings, perhaps even too much so. After some time together, however, these people end up being swayed by her humble and gentle nature.

In keeping with her "Yamato nadeshiko" image, cooking is Kimie's greatest passion. She was personally tutored in cooking by Madam Kaede, and her education was supplemented by oral feedback from worshippers or nearby residents bringing gifts to the shrine. Her general wisdom and comprehension are enough to reproduce just about any dish she is told about in appearance and taste, even without a sample of the original for reference.

Still, Kimie could not handle everything just by staying in the shrine. She knew very little about advances in technology, as well as the media and entertainment in general. During her three years spent traveling with Madam Kaede, most of the people she came into contact with were from old villages who still kept the faith, which gave her little opportunity to come into contact with the outside world. Her understanding of new phenomena largely ended with her regarding them as "the blessings and punishments of the gods". On the other hand, this way of thinking helped her discard her flighty nature and helped her find inner calm and peace.
 
"There's something calming about her that makes one want to get close to her," many worshippers reported. Most people did not know the source of this serenity, but they chose to trust in their instincts.

Due to the special nature of her job, Kimie was often asked to take part in exorcisms, where she would function similarly to an onmyoji. With modern onmyoji being a rare sight nowadays, a miko became the best choice for banishing spirits. This exposed Kimie to quite a few ghost stories and occult tales, as well as various folk stories and beliefs. Thanks to the appeal of her "database of the supernatural", she became fast friends with Zangyin and Nora, always willing to share new ghost stories on even the hottest summer days. Zangyin's hamming up of the atmosphere and Kuro's terrified reactions to them soon became a unique way of easing the Oasis' summer heat.
 
Despite being naturally equipped to be the bane of all things supernatural, this does not mean that Kimie fears nothing. An accident that occurred in real life left her with a fear of fire and made it hard for her to work a stove and cook. Her high-performance emotional modules mean that she empathizes easily with others, but this carries a side effect with them—hypersensitivity. For this reason, Madam Kaede performed a full revamp of Kurenoyume Shrine and equipped it with comprehensive fire safety measures. It was when Kimie could once again relax and play with the children with sparklers during the summer festival that Madam Kaede could once again smile in contentment. Thanks to this immaculate care and concern, this trauma did not follow Kimie to the Oasis, and she has always remained a humble, kind, and gentle yet mighty shrine maiden in the eyes of others.

The term "center of attention" was not normally a term that would be applied to Kimie. Still, the search for the "spirited away" Nora ended up putting Kimie live on stream, and soon the Oasis' anonymous message boards were filled with avid fans of her. As a result, Kimie became a common guest on Kuro's occult-focused streams. After joining the cast, a certain rip-off merchant's cyber-talismans saw a huge drop in sales. According to reliable sources, these cyber-talismans have begun spreading in other sectors as a form of pre-battle physical intimidation. Media exposure soon led to an increase in Kurenoyume Shrine's popularity, and the shrine would fill up with visitors during major festivals, a stark contrast from its quiet, seemingly haunted atmosphere on most days. The visiting agents love to ask Kimie to cast lots for them, and the accuracy of those divinations even won the approval of Luna, the Oasis' premier fortune-teller. Soon, everyone began to wonder, between these two spiritualists, whose divination abilities were superior? As one of the relevant parties, Kimie merely said, "I cannot speculate on matters of the divine", with an enigmatic look on her face. Since she had said as such, the curious audience had no choice but to rein in their curiosity. However, there is one thing that they know for sure—after a long period of hanging around Croque, Kimie has started to become engrossed in video games. She enjoys action games and visual novels, with her favorites being the dark fantasy titles with grueling but fair difficulty from Since Software, such as Dork Souls, Mudborne, Golden Ring, and so on. Not long after arriving in the Oasis, Kimie showed off a brand new side of herself, though the other facets of her will require careful and patient excavation by her friends.
oathDesc: She holds you close and accompanies you, banishes misfortune, and prays for eternal happiness.

projections.name: Kagura Maiden
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"My calling is to join the mundane to the spiritual, to delight the gods and grant guidance to the people of the world."

projections.name: Kagura Maiden
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"My calling is to join the mundane to the spiritual, to delight the gods and grant guidance to the people of the world."

projections.name: Cherry Blossom Splendor
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"The pink cherry blossoms flutter between the trees, while the lonesome moon reflects in the water as flowers carpet the earth."

skinList.name: Red Spring Rimefrost
skinList.desc:
The Dolls change into meticulously chosen outfits, waving goodbye to the last year amidst the sound of firecrackers and worldly delights.
The remnant snow of spring fades, and an alluring figure dons a different color for the season of spring.
""'Tis the day to depart from the past and receive that which is new. May adversities scatter and our auspices be favorable. Shall we convey these thoughts to the divinities together?""

skinList.name: Vow of Frosty Sakura
skinList.desc:
The sakura petals drift gently, guided along a red thread, fortunate enough to find its way to you through the rifts and tribulations of time.
""Worldly ties are born of affection, and end in companionship. With the heavens as witness, Kimie shall always follow you, never once looking back.""
